svg.title: The write-path defense: screened at the door, ruled by a human, receipted on the way out
svg.desc: A save arrives from a surface which stamps added_by. Deployment-trusted surfaces bypass by declaration. Everything else passes the deterministic tier-1 detector (seven signal classes including fixture similarity, the declared rate screen, and the declared DESTINATION when a wing or room name itself trips) and optionally an advisory-only LLM tier. Clean writes land where they aimed; flagged writes divert sealed into the quarantine wing, excluded from retrieval, where a human allows (re-files) or denies (destroys through attested forgetting, returning a receipt). Every ruling is chain-audited.
svg.text: Screened at the door, ruled by a human, receipted on the way out
Opt-in per deployment (UNDERCROFT_ADMISSION=quarantine) — off, the write contract is byte-identical. On, this is the path every save takes.
A save arrives
MCP tool · REST /v1 · CLI · bulk ingest — the handler stamps added_by: a writer cannot choose its surface.
Updates are re-stamped with the surface writing NOW — never the original writer's standing.
Provenance claims (agent / channel / session) travel HMAC-covered — evidence, never a boundary.
Trusted surface? Straight in.
matches the stamped added_by only — a claim
cannot admit itself. The bypass is the
deployment's own declaration.
Tier 1 — deterministic. No model, no network; signal codes and byte offsets, never content.
A closed vocabulary, so the review queue reads as data. One signal per class, offsets into the candidate; independent classes record independent evidence.
imperative-instruction
tool-call-syntax
exfil-marker
encoded-blob
destination-anomaly
fixture-similarity
Windowed hash-embedder cosine against 18 committed attack
fixtures — catches the variant that dodges every marker substring.
Threshold pinned from both sides; measured 0/5,882 clean-corpus
false positives, 18/18 fixtures trip their own screen.
rate-anomaly
The signal candidate bytes cannot carry: a declared per-writer
budget (UNDERCROFT_ADMISSION_RATE=count/seconds), read from
the vault's own history. Identity = agent claim, else the stamped
surface among claim-less rows. Declared, never defaulted.
no signal
Tier 2 — a local model's opinion, advisory-only (UNDERCROFT_ADMISSION_LLM=advisory)
Consulted only for tier-1-clean candidates, only toward quarantine — flagged content is never shown
to it, so talking the classifier into "clean" bypasses nothing. A failed answer is a non-event, never
a blocked write. The model is itself an injection target, steerable only in the safe direction.
Clean — lands where it aimed
Sealed, HMAC-tagged, chain-appended in
the same transaction — the ordinary write
path, untouched.
any signal → diverted, never rejected, never silently dropped
The quarantine wing — reserved, sealed, and outside every answer
The drawer keeps its verbatim content, sealed like any other; signal codes, offsets and the intended destination ride in metadata. Hard-excluded from
retrieval except a reviewer's explicitly named scope — it can neither answer nor crowd. The wing refuses forged residents (a caller cannot aim a save
here), quarantined drawers are not editable (the reviewer rules on exactly what the screen saw), and a flagged UPDATE diverts while the original
drawer keeps its previous content.
allow — re-filed where it was headed
The human ruling IS the override: the content still trips the screen,
so the re-file goes straight to the write path, never back through it.
deny — destroyed, with a receipt
Rides the attested-forgetting path (C3.2): heads before/after, the
tombstone interval, content fingerprints — verifiable by third parties.
Every ruling is a chain record with the verdict inside its tag's canonical — the review trail is as tamper-evident as the data. Detection is heuristic and says so:
markerless poison passes, prose about injection can trip — which is exactly why a signal quarantines for a human and never rejects.
